title: Program 0020: Branch-aware indexing
summary: Program plan sequencing phases 3-6 to deliver branch-aware indexing with privacy-first ingestion, CAS delta refresh, provenance, and scoped retrieval.
notes: Execution/program plan under docs/plans. Status: Proposed and it defers the decision to ADR-0020, so not an ADR. Delivery contract and phase exit gates read like acceptance criteria (PRD signal) but there are no user stories, goals framed as program delivery, and no API/schema contracts (no SPEC signal). Classified DOC as planning context; a synthesizer may wish to treat the numbered delivery-contract clauses as derived requirements.
